about: The HPOP reference cases (the Orekit 13.1 suite, tests/orekit-summary.mjs) in a tool-neutral form. Every cross-validation runner reads this file: initial states, epochs, constants, Earth orientation rows, space weather, force settings, sample epochs and integrator step settings. Generated by tests/evidence/cases/export-cases.mjs from the committed fixtures listed under sources.

protocol.score: largest 3D position difference over the 25 hourly samples, metres, in GCRF (EME2000 for the cases whose frame is EME2000)

rows.fullNoDrag: field, third bodies, radiation pressure, tides, relativity, thrust (no drag)

protocol.stepSettingsForReferenceTools: A reference tool runs at its own converged setting (stated with its results, with the change a finer setting makes); the three settings are HPOP's side of the comparison. A tool that exposes step control may also be run at the same three settings.
protocol.sensitivities: Cases with sensitivities report the 6x6 STM and the parameter columns at each sample; scored as the largest relative difference of a column (position rows and velocity rows apart), as tests/lib/orekitCases.mjs scoreJacobians. Parameters are per unit Cd*A/m, Cr*A/m, the Cd*A/m rate, and the in-track acceleration.

gmat.dragNote: GMAT evaluates the atmosphere with the Sun and spacecraft in J2000 (MJ2000Eq) axes; HPOP uses the true equator of date and keeps it (owner 2026-10-09)

timeScales.integrationClock: TT (geocentric motion); ephemerides are read at TDB

EGM2008.note: fully normalized, tide-free; the coefficients HPOP embeds. tests/fixtures/orekit/make-gfc.mjs writes them as ICGEM .gfc, tests/fixtures/xval/egm2008-cof.mjs as GMAT .cof

EGM96.note: fully normalized; the coefficients HPOP embeds (make-gfc.mjs ... egm96)

models.earthOrientation: IERS 2010 conventions, IAU 2006/2000A CIO-based GCRS to ITRS, with the daily IERS finals2000A rows below; the Orekit reference adds the IERS 2010 sub-daily tidal and libration corrections to polar motion and UT1 (getITRF(IERS_2010, false)); a simple-EOP Orekit run without them is scored in tests/evidence/orekit/summary-simple-eop.json

eop-2026-08.source: IERS finals2000A.all (Bulletin A columns), the file in the Orekit data directory used for orekit-reference.json

eop-2026-06.source: IERS finals2000A.all (Bulletin A columns), the file in the Orekit data directory used for orekit-reference.json

cssi.source: Synthetic SpaceWeather-All-v1.2.txt (make-synthetic-weather.mjs): invented values in the layout of the CelesTrak/CSSI file, read by Orekit for the W1 cases of orekit-reference.json

jb2008.source: Synthetic SOLFSMY.TXT and DTCFILE.TXT (make-synthetic-weather.mjs): invented values in the layout of Space Environment Technologies' files, read by Orekit for the J1 cases of orekit-reference.json

orekitReference.tool: Orekit 13.1 (CS GROUP, Apache-2.0), DormandPrince853 (steps <= 10 s), GCRF; NRLMSISE-00 on mean local solar time

gmat.tool: GMAT R2022a (NASA GSFC, Apache-2.0; GmatConsole, Build Date: Jan 11 2023  15:45:41), PrinceDormand78 at 1e-13 (steps <= 60 s); state in ICRF axes at the epoch, samples from the MJ2000Eq integration axes by the epoch's fixed rotation; Earth orientation IAU 1976/1980 (FK5) with the pole and UT1-UTC of ../orekit/eop-2026-08.json; Sun and Moon from DE440 via SPICE; drag Jacchia-Roberts

tudatpy.tool: Tudat via tudatpy 1.0.0 (TU Delft, BSD-3-Clause; tudat-team conda channel), RKDP 8(7) fixed steps (10 s; 1 s with radiation pressure) on a TT clock, Lagrange-8 to the samples, GCRS axes about the Earth; Earth orientation IERS 2010 (IAU 2006/2000A, CIO) with the rows of ../orekit/eop-2026-08.json; Sun and Moon from DE440 (SPICE, tabulated in GCRS); NRLMSISE-00 with constant space weather

tudat-wasm.tool: Tudat 1.0.0.dev4 as built by repos/ancillary-packages/tudat-wasm (Emscripten 3.1.51, its vendored Tudat sources), driven by tudat_wasm_driver.cpp under Node; same setup as tudatpy-reference.json (RKDP 8(7) fixed steps, 10 s or 1 s with radiation pressure, TT clock, Lagrange-8 to the samples, GCRS about the Earth, IERS 2010 Earth orientation with the rows of ../orekit/eop-2026-08.json, DE440 tabulated in GCRS, NRLMSISE-00 constant space weather)

nyx.tool: Nyx Space 2.6.0 with ANISE 0.10.6 (MPL-2.0), RK8(9) at 1e-13 (steps <= 60 s), SPICE J2000 (ICRF) axes about the Earth; field in ITRF93 from NAIF earth_latest_high_prec.bpc; Sun and Moon from DE440; NRLMSISE-00 with constant space weather

forces.solidTides: IERS 2010 section 6.2 (no pole tide), tidal coefficients sampled every 60 s
